facts.text: The guide labels this as the first of three typical short-form examples intended to address mass timber construction issues.
The described proposal is a new 3-storey community centre, library and natatorium with Group A, Division 2 major occupancy, using hybrid mass timber and concrete construction.

The example cites Sentence 3.2.2.24.(2) of the BC Building Code 2018 and objectives F02-OS1.2 and F02-OP1.2; it contrasts noncombustible construction with using mass timber beyond what the guide says Division B, Subsection 3.1.5 permits.

The guide says the rationale chiefly used enhanced reliability of fire-control/suppression, an enhanced exiting strategy and fire-department access, with discussion of pre-flashover and post-flashover conditions.
